signals.title: Dana Brooks in #sales-wins
signals.text: SIGNED: Contoso, 3-year deal, $2.4M ARR. Biggest deal of the year. Huge thanks to @Leo Kim for the security review marathon and @Ama Owusu for turning the MSA around in 4 days.

signals.title: Rachel Stein in #sales
signals.text: Q4 check-in: we're at $14.6M of our $18M new-ARR target with 5 weeks left. Contoso moved us 13 points this week. Next up: two enterprise pilots (Fabrikam, Tailspin) kick off Monday.

signals.title: Leo Kim in #sales
signals.text: Reminder: please log demo notes in the CRM within 24h of the call.

signals.title: Maya Chen in #payments
signals.text: Apple Pay is live in all 12 launch countries as of Tuesday. Early read after 4 days: checkout conversion went from 3.1% to 3.6% on mobile web. Google Pay in the same countries is next.
